evidence.contractFinalizedBy: Desktop read-only fallback against immutable deployed Server/Web sources
evidence.versionObservation: Read-only deployed inventory and live public API report Server/Web 12.2.0, release 12.2-syncplay.1. Container image and immutable source commits match the release manifest. No separate server-agent API handoff was found.

syncPlay.subscriptionCallback: Message contains Data; each subscription closure supplies its fixed message type.

command.whenEncoding: ISO timestamp with timezone; the Web manager may convert it to Date in the shared payload.

driftAcceptance.measurement: Compare actual client positions on a common time scale; agree scenario tolerances during final qualification.

nativePlayback.nativeRateAcknowledgment: boolean; rejected latest request restores the last acknowledged rate and shows a throttled fixed warning
nativePlayback.externalAudio: asynchronous addition, unique request generation, latest wanted selection, deduplication and stale demuxer removal

authentication.standardHeader: Authorization: MediaBrowser Client=..., Device=..., DeviceId=..., Version=..., Token=...; the served Web client owns authentication
authentication.api_key: do not generate the rejected query spelling

requiredSourceHeaders.reason: The pinned source schema provides a dictionary but no origin/redirect guarantee. Existing Desktop does not forward it: mpv per-file http-header-fields also apply to external tracks and redirects. Header-dependent direct remote sources require a separately specified scoped-header implementation or a server-mediated URL.

playbackInfo.queryCompatibility: Obsolete query parameters still override corresponding body parameters in this pinned version
playbackInfo.indexMapping: Index belongs to the Jellyfin MediaStreams list; native embedded track selection uses the relative stream index of the selected type, not Index directly
playbackInfo.subtitleSelection: -1 or null disables subtitles; Encode is handled by server transcoding, External uses the delivered URL
playbackInfo.externalAudio: Prefer DeliveryUrl; otherwise derive the authenticated progressive Audio/{itemId}/stream.{codec} URL from the existing video stream origin/subpath with matching MediaSourceId and AudioStreamIndex and EnableRedirection=false
playbackInfo.urlPreparation: Native video advertises useFullSubtitleUrls=true. The pinned Web client resolves leading-slash DeliveryUrl values through apiClient.getUrl before passing options to the native player
playbackInfo.authUrlHandling: Preserve supplied Web URLs and their ApiKey spelling; do not copy authorization headers to another origin or add legacy api_key
playbackInfo.missingFields: Unknown stream indexes fall back to the existing native selection; missing external audio URL generation does not create an invented endpoint

syncPlayRateApi.unsupportedBody: ProblemDetails with code=SyncPlayPlaybackRateNotSupported and numeric unsupportedParticipants
syncPlayRateApi.standardServerWithoutExtension: Unsupported/missing route is an error in the served Web SyncPlay implementation; Desktop does not replace it with a local group-rate change
syncPlayRateApi.clientSupport: Native acknowledges valid per-mille values; in a stock SyncPlay group without playbackManager._localSetPlaybackRate it advertises PlaybackRate=false and rejects non-1x local setters with a visible warning. The pinned custom Web wrapper preserves that function and advertises SupportsSyncPlayPlaybackRate=true
syncPlayRateApi.groupRateOwnership: The served Web SyncPlay wrapper sends the group request; only an ordinary server command updates group base rate. Native local setters apply confirmed base rates and bounded local corrections

diagnostics.normalBuild: local numeric metrics only while capture is active

pendingReleaseGate: If the server-agent handoff selects a different Server/Web pair, revise this source-pinned contract and repeat client compatibility checks before release.
RequiredHttpHeaders forwarding remains unsupported; do not enable it without an explicit origin, external-track and redirect contract.
Agree and measure SyncPlay drift tolerances during integrated qualification; protocol defaults alone are not passing evidence.
Qualify the final Windows build and record the user's single integrated application/feature acceptance.
